$comment: Contract fixtures for the pipeline service the console calls (apps/auto-studio/studio_pipeline_service.py, default http://127.0.0.1:8800).
One entry per METHOD + path the browser requests. Served by tests/helpers/mockService.ts so CI needs no Python service, database or GPU box.

POLICY: status/response mirror the TRACKED service handler as read on 2026-11-10. Where the console needs more than the tracked service gives, the shape it expects is in target_response and tests opt in explicitly.
tracked=false means the console calls a route the tracked service does not implement; the fixture answers 404 like the real service does.
UNVERIFIED: derived by reading handler code, not by running the service (it cannot be imported from a clean checkout until spec decision D1). Re-check against a provider test when it can.
Drift guard: lib/serviceContract.test.ts fails if console source calls a service path that has no entry here.
via_response_of: the console never writes this path; it follows a URL returned by the named endpoint, so the drift guard cannot see a call site for it.
response_by_op: for one path with several shapes, the mock picks the body by the request's `op`; `response` is the fallback.
